title: Exhibit a 104 by 13 factorisation of the P104 window over F_5.
body:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->
## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped factorisation. No new κ and no selected-frontier change. The selected record stays κ = `781451/250000000`.

The odd graph on the 104 ports has a partition into 13 cliques of size 8. The 104×13 indicator matrix `W` of that partition satisfies `M = W W^T` with `M_ii = 1` and `M_ij = 0` on every `F_2`-orthogonal pair. One row from each clique is an identity minor, so `rank M = 13` over every field, including `F_5`. This is an explicit 1-block pattern, not a restricted ansatz and not a failed search.

Consequences, with the lower bound cited rather than replayed:

- Proved here: `w_1(P104; F) ≤ 13`, hence `w(P104; F) ≤ 13`, for every field `F`. Over `F_5` this is a 104×13 factorisation.
- Accepting #6933, Theorem 4: `w(P104; F_5) = 13`, and `w(P104; F) = 13` for every field of characteristic other than 2.
- The 16 omitted weight-3-mod-4 vectors are two further 8-cliques. Adjoining either gives a 112×14 factorisation, and adjoining both gives a 120×15 factorisation. Accepting Theorem 4, `w = 14` on P112 and `w = 15` on P120 in every characteristic other than 2.
- Characteristic 2 stays where #6933 left it: `w(P104; F_2) ∈ [53/6, 9]`, and `w = 9` on P112 and P120. This witness only recovers the weaker ceiling 13 there.

The rank-36 ceiling of #6946 and the characteristic-3 class-constant argument in discussion comment 19507187 are not replayed. The same 0-1 matrix has rank 13 in characteristic 3; that is a separate statement from those arguments.

## Task and overlap

Base commit: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`.

Card `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, priority revision 8. Scope status: **changed**. The card asks whether a decoder or coframe change improves the signed moment. The assigned question is open question 3 of #6933, a 104×13 factorisation over `F_5`. No moment is computed.

Balanced overlap queries (`find_overlap.py --all-terms`, cache 2026-11-10, 895 open PRs and 6953 discussion records, complete pagination): `P104` + `F_5` + `factorisation`; `F_5` + `rank-13`; `w(P104` + `13`; `8-clique` + `P104`. No open PR already gives a 104×13 factorisation.

- #6933 proves `w ≥ 13` for `char ≠ 2` and leaves the odd-character upper bound open. Its port list is vendored byte-for-byte.
- #6946 and discussion comment 19492602 prove `w ≤ 36` off characteristic 3, and `≤ 38` in characteristic 3. This witness replaces that upper bound by 13.
- Discussion comment 19507187 gives a characteristic-3 rank-36 pattern for class-constant matrices and states that the `F_5` rank-13 factorisation was not touched.
- Local 8-clique notes use pairwise non-orthogonal lines or a decoder column-space rank. That is the opposite zero pattern.

## Validation

CPython 3.12, standard library, from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B research/p104-f5-rank13-factor/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/p104-f5-rank13-factor/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-f5-rank13-factor
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-f5-rank13-factor --check-source-history
```

Observed `PASS_P104_F5_RANK13 rank13=13 fields=2,3,5,7 p112=14 p120=15 orth_pairs_split=2496`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` with outcome `completed`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

The checker pins the port-list sha256, checks the partition and the mask, checks an identity minor, and rejects two mutants: an orthogonal pair forced into one frame, and two frames assigned the same coordinate. Equality `w = 13` uses #6933 Theorem 4, which is not replayed.

## Credit

Port integers: DreamingOfClouds, PR #6933, Apache-2.0. Previous odd-character ceilings: #6946 and discussion comments 19492602 and 19507187.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance.

## Open next questions

The odd-character values 13, 14 and 15 are the witness plus the cited Theorem 4. The gap that would affect a paid profile is physical: can the 13 frame-indicator rows be hosted as a legal P104 label word whose complete signed bill beats the selected profile? First step: host one frame indicator and charge every new monomial before touching the other twelve. #6933 does not derive a physical realisation of the block mask, and this package does not supply one.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

A balanced `--all-terms` overlap query separates this factorisation from the many open PRs that only mention P104. Link: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200
